# Atlassian MCP Servers

> 280 MCP tools for Jira, Confluence, JSM, and JPD integration with AI assistants.

## For AI Agents Using These Tools

- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Workflows, patterns, best practices for tool consumers

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](docs/getting-started.md): Setup and configuration
- [Tool Catalog](docs/tool-catalog.md): Complete tool reference (280 tools)
- [Optimization Guide](docs/optimization-guide.md): Deferred loading and tool use examples

## Servers

| Server | Tools | Focus |
|--------|-------|-------|
| [jira-projects](servers/jira-projects/README.md) | 60 | Issues, projects, dashboards |
| [jira-workflows](servers/jira-workflows/README.md) | 39 | Workflows, screens, automation |
| [confluence](servers/confluence/README.md) | 69 | Spaces, pages, content |
| [jira-service-desk](servers/jira-service-desk/README.md) | 12 | JSM service desks, customers |
| [jira-organization](servers/jira-organization/README.md) | 31 | Users, groups, org admin |
| [jira-fields-permissions](servers/jira-fields-permissions/README.md) | 31 | Custom fields, permissions |
| [jira-system-admin](servers/jira-system-admin/README.md) | 21 | System settings, audit |
| [jira-product-discovery](servers/jira-product-discovery/README.md) | 12 | JPD ideas, insights |
